# Links in a terminal tab (term_links.odin): ⌘ held underlines the link under
# the pointer and shows its target; ⌘-click opens it (http(s): a browser tab of
# the session, in front; mailto: the mail app), ⇧⌘-click in the default
# browser; right-click: Open link, Open in default browser, Copy link. An OSC 8
# link with a javascript: target is no link. Run with tests/scripts/term-links.sh
# (it writes ~/links.txt: an OSC 8 link, a URL in brackets, a refused OSC 8
# link, a mail link and a URL that soft-wraps onto the next row).
wait 1000
waitfor ARGS: 15000
command {"type":"new_shell_tab","session":$session}
wait 800
command {"type":"send_text","tab_id":$tab,"text":"clear; cat ~/links.txt\n"}
waitfor ZEND 5000
# no ⌘: no link
mousecell hover 4 0
assert_link -
# ⌘ held: the OSC 8 link, its target in the tip
mousecell hover 4 0 cmd
assert_link https://example.com/osc8
wait 100
assert_drawn https://example.com/osc8
shot term-links/hover
mousecell hover 4 0
assert_link -
assert_not_drawn https://example.com/osc8
# ⇧⌘-click: the default browser
mousecell click 4 0 cmd shift
assert_opened https://example.com/osc8
# a URL in text: the bracket and the period are not part of it
mousecell hover 10 1 cmd
assert_link https://example.com/plain?q=1
mousecell click 10 1 cmd shift
assert_opened https://example.com/plain?q=1
# mailto: the mail app, ⌘ alone
mousecell click 8 3 cmd
assert_opened mailto:a@example.invalid
# a URL soft-wrapped onto the next row, clicked on its second row
mousecell click 3 5 cmd shift
assert_opened https://example.
# javascript: from OSC 8 is never a link (nothing opens)
mousecell hover 2 2 cmd
assert_link -
mousecell click 2 2 cmd
assert_opened https://example.
# a plain click on a link selects, nothing opens
mousecell click 4 0
assert_opened https://example.
# right-click on a link: its menu (the URL, Open link, Open in default browser, Copy link)
mousecell rclick 4 0
wait 200
assert_drawn Open link
assert_drawn Open in default browser
assert_drawn Copy link
shot term-links/menu
clickid menurow 3
assert_opened https://example.com/osc8
# ⌘ let go while a field has the keyboard: the link is no longer underlined
ui_command {"type":"set_focus","widget":"sidebar_filter"}
mousecell hover 4 0 cmd
assert_link https://example.com/osc8
key lcmd
assert_link -
assert_not_drawn https://example.com/osc8
ui_command {"type":"set_focus","widget":""}
# ⌘ held over a link while a sheet covers the terminal: no tip, no link
mousecell hover 4 0 cmd
assert_link https://example.com/osc8
ui_command {"type":"set_focus","widget":"shortcuts"}
wait 200
assert_link -
assert_not_drawn https://example.com/osc8
ui_command {"type":"set_focus","widget":""}
mousecell hover 4 0
# a program that tracks the mouse: ⌃-click on a link is the right-click menu,
# ⌃-click elsewhere and ⌘⌃-click on a link go to the program (cat -v shows them)
command {"type":"send_text","tab_id":$tab,"text":"clear; printf '\\033[?1000h\\033[?1006h'; cat ~/links.txt; echo TRACK''-ON; stty raw -echo; cat -v\n"}
waitfor TRACK-ON 5000
wait 300
mousecell click 4 0 ctrl
wait 200
assert_drawn Open in default browser
key escape
wait 200
mousecell click 20 2 ctrl
mousecell click 4 0 cmd ctrl
waitfor ^[[<16;5;1M 3000
assert_screen ^[[<16;21;3M
assert_opened https://example.com/osc8
# ⌘-click an http link: a browser tab of this session, in front
mousecell click 10 1 cmd
wait 300
assert_state open_sessions.0.tabs.2.kind browser
assert_state open_sessions.0.tabs.2.url https://example.com/plain?q=1
state_json term-links/state
quit
